# Suph.app

> Small projects by Suphian Tweel: The Toga Is Dead, a 3D strategy game for the browser, and Quran Art, a gallery of artworks for all 114 surahs of the Quran.

Small things I build to explore. When a new model or tool comes out, I like to spend a weekend with it and use it to solve a real problem. I don’t plan to support them; they’re experiments I think are worth sharing.

## Projects

- [The Toga Is Dead](https://suph.app/Toga): A 3D board game you play in the browser: 2–4 players, with solo practice, same-screen play and online invitations, set in a medieval coastal kingdom or the Roman empire.
- [Quran Art](https://suph.app/quran): Three mathematical artworks for every surah of the Quran. Explore language through shape, rhythm, and geometry. Each surah has its own page, such as https://suph.app/surah/al-fatihah/, with SVG downloads.
- Coming soon: a looping film of ink blooming in water.

## Pages

- [Gallery](https://suph.app/): The three project cards.

- [Suphian Tweel](https://suphian.com/): Product leader. Led payments at YouTube, 2020 – 2026. Founder of Abacus Labs, a command center for MCA operators. Shares weekend experiments at suph.app.
